name: Aki
quote: With the blade, I shall sever that which causes sorrow and while away the rest of the days.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Oh, good morning.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I know we shouldn't squander daylight, but some good rest is important to keep your motivation high.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Hmm... I think I'll make myself some unagi rice tonight!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Working so late into the night... You really are a tough one.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: The blade can be a chivalrous tool, or a murder weapon... The morality of it, or lack thereof, is solely up to the wielder's decisions.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: And... the Professor's gone in the blink of an eye.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Well... Guess I'm going back for some rest. Hmm? You're coming with me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: I see.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: What's the matter? You want to play with me?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: What the...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: So you're the Professor they've been talking about, huh? My name is Aki. Nice to meet you.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Hmm, my skills seem to have further improved.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: That's remarkable progress. Beef tongue for dinner it is!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: In the whirlpool of time, even an obscure blade can leave its mark in the history books.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I'll take care of it.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: The battle is about to begin.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Slash!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: We've put them six feet under.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Oh, is that all?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: The defeated are destined to fall like cherry blossoms...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Hmm? ... I see. It's long been obvious to me that there is something special about you. This must be the world beyond that screen... I'm glad you brought me out here.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: New Year's Day should be spent in comfort. Well... I'll go get some roasted persimmon seeds and banana milk. How about we go and watch TV in a kotatsu together?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Add some chocolate sauce into Azuki bean jelly, and you'll get chocolate jelly... Combine that with a matcha tea, and you've got the perfect treat for a break. Oh, could it be? Are you going to make some for me?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: During summers... It would be nice to stay inside all day with the air-conditioner on. Even better if we can have some iced watermelon. But if you want to watch the fireworks outside, it's not like I can't accompany you.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: WAH! —Now how was that, did I scare you? Hahahaha! Legend has it that Shuten Doji had a bright red face and 15 eyeballs. It's a lot scarier than this crappy outfit! ... But in the end, he was still slain by Dojikiri Yasutsuna.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: "The bells of the Holy Night ring, the night sky is full of snow." I once heard a song like that. It would surely be a beautiful sight if it snowed in the Oasis... Hmm? Wait, is that... snow outside?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Today is an important day, no? As you've grown one year older, the responsibilities you have to shoulder have grown as well. But don't worry! You can always count on me should you encounter any unsolvable conundrums. Happy birthday, and I wish you all the best.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: The practice of swordsmanship is not to repeat day after day, tracing one action after the other. You'll grow fatigued of it sooner or later. Adequate rest and even entertainment are important too. In my case, I spend 18 hours a day sleeping, watching TV, and taking baths to keep my mind in balance... That's what I call my special way of training.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: It is unbecoming of a man such as I to start fights unprovoked. But if someone I care about is endangered, my blade will be first to plunge through the enemy's throat, even if the hostile is a human... Admittedly, that's mostly because I find quarrelling to be a hassle.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Haahh... I'm so sleepy during this season. Springtime is too beautiful to be spent training and summertime induces drowsiness. Autumn has its bug nuisances, and during winter it snows all day long. Better keep my blades shelved as the new year comes... Hmm? Oh, it's about time NotREAL?'s live broadcast starts!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: The human body can dull like a sword does without proper maintenance. So, Professor, would you like to train with me? I've got specially made wooden swords prepared for such occasions. Are you ready? I'll be coming at you!

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
It is a samurai's duty to pledge allegiance to his lord. Now that I've put it that way, there's not much difference between a samurai and a bodyguard like me.
A human's heart and nature can change over time, but a Doll cannot escape the shackles of its programming. That being said, one can never see what's on the other side before pushing through the barrier.
... Of course, none of that really matters compared to my kotatsu, persimmon seeds, banana milk, and idol shows. Right, Professor?

career:
Bodyguard, the Doll model of Universal Anything Services (UAS), specializes in providing security services to the upper class. Exceptional in quality and pricey in cost, it can adapt to many complex workplaces and provide the highest levels of safety to the employer.

As a special Bodyguard model, limitations in certain empathic functions had been removed from Aki when he was made. Out of practical considerations, neither the employer nor the producer informed Aki about the removal.

As per the employer's request, Aki joined Project Neural Cloud without knowing the true intention of the employer.
infoStories:
Rather than a bodyguard, Aki gives others the impression of being an approachable young man of the upper class. His unique temperament is most likely the result of his employer's influence, to some extent.

Aki's employer was a swordmaster, who demanded that Aki's weapon of choice be set to the Tachi when he was made.

In their days together, the master also taught him many unique sword techniques in person. Although importing data into Dolls would be more efficient, both the master and Aki rather enjoyed this conventional method of teaching.

Despite his physical appearance, Aki is quite childlike in several ways. For example, he enjoys wearing bear-themed accessories and is a bit of a picky eater, often fretting over his food's flavor.

Despite this, when confronted with crisis, Aki demonstrates a fortitude that contrasts his regular demeanor. With his behavior code limitation lifted, Aki exhibits no restraint when faced with humans or Dolls, resulting in a burst of power significantly more impressive than that of his peers.

Despite being the master's guard, Aki had little chance for combat. They stayed away from worldly troubles and lived in the mountains, and the sporadic intrusions were simply dealt with by the guards.

Aki's first opponent was a middle-aged man who used a blunt long sword to break through the perimeter guards. However, as he stormed into the courtyard, he was quickly detained by Aki.

Later, Aki discovered that the middle-aged man was the master's son. It was also the first time Aki learned about the master's past. He had a large number of children, as it turned out. Despite having been a hermit for long, he had a great reputation in the outside world.

"Hey, old man, with all of your children, why do you still live here alone?"
"You ask too many questions."
"Bah. You don't have to tell me if you don't want to."
"Even if I told you, you wouldn't understand."
"That's correct. Humans are far too roundabout for my liking."
"Tsk. How dare a bodyguard make fun of their boss? Perhaps you have too much free time on your hands. I'll give you something to do."
"Please don't! I'm going to patrol the yard right now!"
"Haha, you brat!"
—Project Neural Cloud Special Client's Recording

Although Aki was not sure why the master requested him to join Project Neural Cloud, he didn't think much of it. As a Doll, all he had to do was obey his employer's orders—at least, that's what Aki had thought.

But as the departure date approached, Aki was tormented by plenty of inexplicable emotions. He began nagging the master about some concerning matters, complaining about the carelessness of other servants, and even feeling anxious about being alone with the master.

"I don't think I'll be able to join the Project. There appears to be a bug in my Neural Cloud System."
"Pug? What pug? You got a pug?"
"... No, I mean, there appears to be a problem with my neural system. You must have seen it. I was a little... What was the word? I'm a bit unsettled."
"Oh, I see. Who can say? Perhaps this is your first time leaving the house, and you're feeling apprehensive."
"Huh? How could I possibly be..."
"Alright, alright. Don't overthink things. If you have too much time, let's have some sword practice. Show me the technique you learned the other day. Come on!"
—Project Neural Cloud Special Client's Recording

Aki isn't concerned about being confined in the Cloud. He accepts the situation as it is and has never inquired when he will be able to leave.

When he is not on duty, Aki likes to visit the empty land near the Oasis to practice the way of the sword on his own. He may not be a human, but his sensitivity and emotional intuition has allowed him to understand everything that's happened since he inherited his sword from the master.

To my grandson—Aki
—The inscription on the famous sword "Shuten-kiri"

"How could a master trick others? That's not how one should act."
—Interview excerpt between Aki and the Professor
oathDesc: I've got another reason to wield my sword now.

projections.name: Swordsman
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"As a swordsman, I practice how to wield the sword as fast as possible; but when I'm drinking to the moon, I'd like to take it slow. To follow the moment and enjoy a leisurely time, hardly anything else beats the joy of that!"

"As a swordsman, I practice how to wield the sword as fast as possible; but when I'm drinking to the moon, I'd like to take it slow. To follow the moment and enjoy a leisurely time, hardly anything else beats the joy of that!"

projections.name: Dreams of Autumn Leaves
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The sword is like a song resonating in my dusty dream."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"A good autumn is a cool one, it's the perfect time to sleep..."

skinList.name: Whistling Sunday
skinList.desc:
"Otium" Series — Doing as the heart desires, abandoning convention. Doing away with strict and orderly uniform, returning to one's true self in brief moments of respite.
"Where oh where will we go? Since it's the weekend, let's go put those life goals to the side, yeah? Let's go get some unagidon."

skinList.name: Unsheathed Edge
skinList.desc: The first awakening of Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection— "Whew... I wanted to sleep a while longer. Tell me your name, so that in the future, I can carry out my duties as a swordsman."

skinList.name: Leisurely Drink
skinList.desc:
Snowy Spring — A special outfit that the Dolls wear during the Chinese New Year garden party. Bid farewell to the old and liven up the new with a splash of unique scenery.
"A brand new year ought to be spent at leisure. With the scent of these plum blossoms accompanying me, anything I drink gains a unique flavor. Would you like to try some, Professor?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"I'll hang on to this little guy, but in return, you need to accept this gift too, Professor."
